$comment: The approved STANDALONE templates (templates/<key>/template.json — repos with their own shape, not packs on the web kernel): the source of truth for which standalone templates the platform repo's publish-templates.sh republishes on every kernel advance. Deliberately a separate manifest from packs/approved.json: that file feeds the compose gate matrix (ci.yml), build-templates-artifact.sh, and the runtime image bakes, none of which can consume a non-composable standalone template. Standalone templates have exactly one publish lane — the GitHub template repos — so this list plus packs/approved.json together are everything publish-templates.sh maintains, and the platform's config doctor (template_sync) requires every offered template to be covered by one of the two. Approving a standalone template is adding its key here (plus the platform's APPROVED_TEMPLATE_KEYS mirror); verify-pack-catalogs.mjs checks every key resolves.
